thread:
anya: heads up — planning a short, staggered maintenance window for pool-redwood-2 tomorrow 03:00-06:00 UTC. goal is to reboot CUDA drivers + apply NIC firmware. keeping it rolling, no full-pool down.
chris: thanks — what's the handoff plan? who owns warmbackfill and prefix cache warmup?
anya: @chris i'll own drain order + backfill. @devex will trigger warmup once nodes are up. sequence: cordon -> drain -> reboot -> smoke -> uncordon. 10 min wait between racks.
max: region note: eu-west-2 has only 8 spare nodes in the pool; we should avoid simultaneous drains that will push customers to fallback models (cost spike). maybe increase burst to dedicated for the window?
jess: can we bump burst for eu-west-2 for 2 hours? cost estimate?
devex: yes we can, but need approval — rough numbers: +$420/hr if we spin 4 x p4d equivalents for the 3h window.
chris: alternative: cross-region route to eu-west-1 for lower-impact customers. but that adds egress and latency. who owns routing policy change?
anya: @infra-oncall configure policy hold for 04:00-05:00 to prefer eu-west-1 for non-enterprise traffic. enterprise routes stay pinned.
infra-oncall: got it. i'll add a temporary routing rule and a rollback at 05:30. will post in #announcements before change.
sre-bot: Incident bot: scheduled maintenance created (id: maint-2024-17450). Reminder DM to oncall at T-30m.
maria: quick check: any KV cache invalidation on drain? we rely on prefix cache for hot prefixes — warmup script should prefetch top-100 prefixes. @devex can you confirm script path?
devex: script is in infra/tools/warmup/prefix_prefetch.sh — usage: `./prefix_prefetch.sh pool-redwood-2 --top 100`. will run 10m after nodes report healthy.
chris: add a smoke test: generate 3x 1k-token requests across top-5 models, validate latency < 200ms p50 and kv-hit rate > 60%. if smoke fails, keep nodes cordoned and rollback routing.
jess: noted. i'll create a quick healthcheck job in scheduler namespace.
max: also check NIC offload flags — last time a firmware swap flipped GRO causing packet bursts. include `ethtool -k` check in the post-boot checklist.
anya: added to checklist. full checklist snippet: 
```
kubectl cordon node-XX
kubectl drain node-XX --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
apply-firmware node-XX
reboot node-XX
wait-for-ready node-XX
run-smoke-tests --models gpt-redwood-2,gpt-embed-1 --latency-threshold 200
run-prefix-warmup --top 100
kubectl uncordon node-XX
```
chris: what about billing tags during warmbackfill? make sure we tag transient nodes with `maintenance=true` so we can reconcile cost to the maintenance ticket.
infra-oncall: will add tagging. also creating a cost alert if transient spend > $1000 during window.
sre-bot: Cost monitor: forecast for window before tags: $1260.
maria: constraint: we still have ongoing Dedicated customer on pool-redwood-2 with reserved tenancy — we must ensure their reservation capacity is untouched. verify the drain order excludes reserved capacity nodes.
anya: good catch. will annotate reserved nodes and skip them in drain. drain order will prefer spot-backed nodes first.
devex: FYI the warmup script can be parallelized across racks: `--concurrency 3` to shorten total time. just be mindful of KV pressure.
chris: communications: draft message to #platform-updates + customer-facing status page. short window, targeted region, no expected downtime for enterprise. will send draft in 10m.
jess: I'll be oncall for smoke and rollback. @max can you stand by for routing/egress tests?
max: available.
anya: final ask — anyone see any other dependencies? databases, storage, or telemetry that need quiescing?
maria: telemetry: disable heavy sampling for 30m to avoid metric spikes, i'll push a config change.
infra-oncall: scheduled: 03:00 cordon starts, 03:05 drain first cohort, expected finish 05:45. posting updates in thread during ops.
sre-bot: Reminder: please include runbook tag `MAINT-17450` in all diffs.
chris: ack. thanks all.
anya: thanks team — will post final plan and public blurb in 20m. :white_check_mark:
